name: Mortis (Cadaverous Animation) — 2 Intermediate — Raise the Corpse to Service

system.description: You can animate a corpse — freshly killed or a moldering skeleton — into a shambling servant. Expend a Blood Trait, dripping it into the body's mouth over three turns, and perform a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty five Traits). Success creates an animated corpse capable of performing the functions of a simple manservant. It cannot speak but can communicate through rudimentary gestures. It continues to decay until only a skeleton is left. Corpses so prepared last three days, and may be raised again after they cease to function.
